title: EviSafe: Evidence-Grounded Safety Evaluation for Vision-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.23313v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Vision-language model safety benchmarks typically evaluate only final responses: whether a model refuses, warns, or complies. This outcome-level view cannot tell whether a model is safe for the right multimodal reason. Safelooking behavior may reflect keyword-triggered refusal, missed visual hazards, or over-refusal of benign-sensitive inputs. We introduce EviSafe, an evidence-grounded framework for VLM safety that jointly evaluates natural user-facing behavior, explicit grounding in textual and visual evidence, and behavioral sensitivity to counterfactual changes in safety-critical evidence. EviSafeBench instantiates the framework as a controlled benchmark with 1,181 gold image-text scenarios and 2,452 targeted counterfactual variants across eight safety domains and eight risk-source types. translated_title: EviSafe：面向视觉语言模型的证据支撑安全评估
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.23313v1 公告类型：新 摘要：视觉语言模型的安全基准通常仅评估最终响应：模型是否拒绝、警告或遵从。这种结果层面的视角无法判断模型是否因正确的多模态原因而安全。表面安全的行为可能反映关键词触发的拒绝、遗漏视觉危险，或对良性敏感输入的过度拒绝。我们引入了EviSafe，一个基于证据的VLM安全评估框架，它联合评估自然用户面向行为、对文本和视觉证据的明确引用，以及对安全关键证据中反事实变化的敏感度。EviSafeBench将该框架实例化为一个受控基准，包含1,181个黄金图像-文本场景和2,452个针对性的反事实变体，覆盖八个安全领域和八种风险源类型。每个场景包括黄金安全决策、证据注释、安全响应策略和反事实干预。三探针协议...
tldr: EviSafe提出了一种证据驱动的视觉语言模型安全评估框架，通过结合行为、证据引用和反事实敏感度三个探针，揭示了模型表面安全行为背后的多模态推理缺陷。
en_tdlr: EviSafe proposes an evidence-grounded framework for VLM safety evaluation that integrates behavioral, evidence-grounding, and counterfactual-sensitivity probes to uncover multimodal reasoning flaws behind superficially safe behaviors.
